prompts.name: courtyard-assembly-landscape
prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one exceptionally detailed documentary-style photograph illustrating Mucheke High School in Masvingo Zimbabwe. The uploaded real photographs are authoritative visual references: white short sleeve shirts, dark purple trousers, ties with diagonal deep purple/light cyan blue/magenta stripes; purple tracksuits with broad white chest/shoulder panels and white accents on trousers; modest low single-storey brick/plastered classroom buildings, corrugated roofs, verandas, mature trees, clipped green courtyard hedges, imperfect concrete paving. The recent generated Downloads image is less authoritative and its navy-white ties must NOT be copied. Students are fictional Black Zimbabwean teenagers with diverse natural individual faces, appropriate hairstyles. Small distant crest only, do not invent readable badge lettering. Natural pores, fine facial hair, creased woven fabric, stitching, worn shoes, textured dusty ground, realistic shadows and restrained colours. Ordinary candid school photography with moderate depth of field, background still legible; no beauty retouching, no waxy skin, no glossy advertising finish, no cinematic orange-teal grading, no identical faces, no watermark or captions. Plausible illustrative scene, not a reconstruction of a real event.
Scene: landscape 3:2 image of morning courtyard assembly viewed diagonally from beside a hedge, 12-18 teenagers in loose rows wearing the exact reference purple and white panelled tracksuits. A student facing peers reads brief announcements from an exercise book, naturally attentive peers with varied postures, a few uniforms slightly faded. Low classroom veranda in background with roof matching real screenshots; cracked concrete walkway, clipped hedge, mature tree. Soft early daylight with believable shadow detail. No stage or auditorium. Output one single photograph.
